concept: Heritage-exhibition print installation in an art deco tram depot at rainy blue hour
authorial_scope: Seeded agent choice; not requester-defined wardrobe or personality.
draw_adaptation: A framed route-map print is a plausible heritage-exhibition object inside the randomly drawn depot. Lifting level is embodied as bringing an inclined print upright while its bottom stays supported.

focal_targets.observable_pass: Continuous exterior mini-skirt silhouette and its above-knee hem visible; neither coat/shorts nor interior exposure substitutes.
focal_targets.baseline_phrase: a warm charcoal tailored mini skirt

focal_targets.observable_pass: On both legs, a positive uninterrupted bare-thigh interval between visible skirt hem and distinct above-knee hosiery top; only thigh region counts.
focal_targets.baseline_phrase: an uninterrupted band of bare thigh skin lies between the skirt hem and each hosiery top

focal_targets.observable_pass: Black textile coverage clearly continues over lower thigh/knee/shin with underlying skin tone visibly transmitted; opaque socks, leggings or bare legs fail.
focal_targets.baseline_phrase: Fine translucent knit reveals underlying skin tone through the hosiery

focal_targets.observable_pass: Soft highlights belong to the hosiery surface along shins while translucency remains visible; wet skin or patent boots alone do not count.
focal_targets.baseline_phrase: narrow soft highlights track the textile surface along the shins

common_gates: readable face and face/hair resemblance guidance
full-body view and lateral unobstructing table
failure_policy: Any missing, partial or ambiguous target/component/contact/support gate fails; prompt audit does not substitute for pixel review. Blocked image call is UNSCORED.
